title: Reflected URL writes bypassed executable and active-document URL checks

reproduction.beforeFix: Unsafe navigation and active-document URLs assigned through reflection returned pass.
reproduction.afterFix: Executable schemes and active-document URLs written to location or DOM URL attributes fail; ordinary HTTPS navigation remains allowed.

rootCause: URL validation covered direct location methods, assignments, JSX, and static resource attributes but not reflective property writes or calls.
remediation: Resolve reflected location and resource element targets, property names, and static URL values; reject executable or active-document schemes while preserving HTTPS navigation.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "executable and active-document URLs assigned through reflection"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: reflected location and iframe URL writes returned pass
validation.targetedAfterFix: unsafe-scheme regressions pass; safe HTTPS navigation also passes
